notes.note: Refs #3568 and #3575. Follow-up source-delta review after the bounded contract review at 129cca80a3d. The profile resolver now uses Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call instead of Object.hasOwn, preserving own-key selection and unknown-profile fallback while compiling under the SDK ES2020 lib. Native declarations, ownership and placement semantics are unchanged. Hosted iOS TS2550 was reproduced locally before the edit; npm run build:sdk now passes and the 15-test profile suite passes. This is a review of these changed inputs only; the prior document purpose, classification and limits remain. No live-provider, device, installed or release qualification is added.

Refs #3568 and #3575. Follow-up source-delta review after the bounded contract review at 129cca80a3d. Rechecked claimed-steer recovery: a conflicting receipt cannot rule out an earlier handoff and now preserves unconfirmed, including the placing-to-recovery path. The existing restart/receipt table covers both already-surfaced and interrupted claims; pre-fix and clean-commit mutation each fail 1 intended assertion / pass 72. Byte-exact restoration passes 73. Text/head custody, no automatic replay and explicit user resend remain as documented. This is a review of these changed inputs only; the prior document purpose, classification and limits remain. No live-provider, device, installed or release qualification is added.
